    if h is not None:

    if m is not None:

    if l is not None:

ii_low = np.array(ii_low_list)
diffs = np.array(diffs)

# Phase medians
median_high = float(np.median(ii_high))
median_mid = float(np.median(ii_mid))
median_low = float(np.median(ii_low))
median_diff = float(np.median(diffs))
mean_diff = float(np.mean(diffs))

print(f"n_paired: {len(diffs)}, n_skipped: {n_skipped}")

B = 10000

count = 0

    if np.median(perm_diffs) >= observed:
